jobs.how: Set AHU Loc/Net to Network at the HMI, then command occupancy with MV 7, or MV 8 when MV 7 is Auto. Emergency Override Off stops the unit; only writing Normal restarts it.

points.use: Read: must be 1 = Network for network writes
Write occupancy mode: 1 Occ, 2 Unocc, 5 Auto
Write scheduler state when MV 7 = Auto
Read: effective occupancy, 1 Occ, 2 Unocc, 3 TntOvrd
Write 2 = Off to stop; 1 = Normal restarts
Read: unit state, e.g. 6 Htg, 7 Econo, 8 Clg

jobs.how: Application Mode only acts when Control Mode is Auto at the HMI. Write occupied and unoccupied space setpoints and discharge air setpoints; read the effective discharge setpoint back.

points.use: Write mode: 1 Off, 2 Heat, 3 Cool, 4 Fan, 5 Auto
Read: effective discharge air temperature setpoint

jobs.how: Read the effective values the controller is using; they may come from a local sensor or a network input.

points.use: Read: entering fan / leaving coil temperature

jobs.how: With Ctrl Mode Auto, enable or cap cooling, heating and economizer from the network. Enables take -1 Null, 0 Off or 1 Enable; read status and capacity to confirm.

points.use: Write cooling enable: -1 Null, 0 Off, 1 Enable
Write heating enable: -1 Null, 0 Off, 1 Enable
Write economizer enable: -1 Null, 0 Off, 1 Enable

jobs.how: Read fan capacity, static pressure and status; write the duct or building static setpoint used by the selected fan control method.

points.use: Read: supply fan duct static pressure, inWC
Write supply fan duct static setpoint, inWC
Write building static pressure setpoint, inWC

jobs.how: Read damper position, airflow and CO2; write network minimum and maximum damper positions or the outdoor airflow setpoint where fitted.

points.use: Write outdoor air damper minimum position input, %
Write outdoor air damper maximum position input, %

jobs.how: There is no BACnet heartbeat: written values hold at the last valid value. Network sensor inputs fall back to the local sensor if the value becomes unreliable.
Read the active fault, problem and warning numbers (0 = none for faults) and the alarm BIs. Write Clear Alarms only to clear an active alarm.

points.use: Write 5 = ClrAllAlms only to clear active alarms
Read: emergency off fault, 0 Open / 1 Closed
Read: fault notification class; subscribe the BAS to it

checklist: Fit the BACnet IP or BACnet MS/TP communication module; IP defaults are DHCP on and UDP 47808, MS/TP defaults are MAC 18, 38400 baud, Max Master 127, Max Info Frames 1.
Change the device instance and network settings at the HMI and set Apply Changes in the BACnet setup menu (the controller restarts).
On MS/TP, fit a physical terminating resistor, because the HMI Term Resistor setting is lost at power-off.
Set AHU Loc/Net to Network at the HMI and confirm MV 19 (AHULoc/Net) reads Network.
Verify reads of MV 15 (UnitState), MV 1 (DaikinStatus), AI 1 (DischAirTemp), AI 3 (EffSpaceTemp) and AI 8 (OutdoorTemp).
Write MV 7 (OccManCmd) = 1 Occ and confirm MV 6 (EffectOccup) follows, then test a write to AV 10 (OccCoolSP) and read it back.
Test MV 10 (EmergOverride) = 2 Off, confirm MV 1 shows OffNet, then write 1 Normal to restart the unit.
If the BMS supplies sensors, write AV 31 (SpaceTempInput) or AV 32 (OutdoorTempInput) and check AI 3 or AI 8 follows.
Map AV 29 (ActiveFault), AV 28 and AV 27; if the BAS cannot subscribe to NC 1-4, enter its device instance in NC Dev 1 or NC Dev 2 and cycle power.
